Name: Abdon, Son of Hillel
Summary: Abdon, son of Hillel, a Pirathonite, judged Israel eight years; he had forty sons and thirty nephews who rode on seventy ass colts.
KeyStory: Abdon judged Israel eight years, and his forty sons and thirty nephews rode on seventy ass colts; he died and was buried in Pirathon in Mount Ephraim.
LifeLesson: A judge's household rode like a parade — seventy ass colts for one family.
